notes.title: One Year !
notes.content:
[b]👁️ Raging Ball and his public :[/b]

It has been exposed 405 887 times (picture was loaded on Steam) ! 80 % of them clicked on it. Among them, 7 951 added Raging Ball to their library (probably thanks to this incredible trailer). Only 1 002 people really downloaded the game ("add-to-library-but-not-play" syndrom).

[b]⌛ Raging Ball lifline :[/b]

For 1 001 players (without me) :

[list]
[*] 680 tourists > less than 10 minutes. It can be explained by the non WASD support... Or the ugly main menu...
[*] 190 haters > 10 minutes. Maybe the double-jump level, the first step of frustation.
[*] 50 adventurers > 30 minutes. You can explain it because some players arrived to the nightmare level (Chapter 1 level 9) or, for the bests, just start the bumper chapters.
[*] 40 reckless > 1 hour. I hope they didn't suffer in vain and they passed the game. Well played !
[*] 41 masochistics cried all the blood of their body for more than 2 hours. They heard the little notes at every fall. They just put this little ball in every corners on every levels. They probably screamed. I think about you guys sometimes. Bravo. 
[/list]

[b]🎨 The future :[/b]

After this quick and chaotic development, I decided to try again this experiment. Hopefully I will bring you a better product. I'm working on a coop adventure game. Meanwhile, don't hesitate to beat the RagingBall speedrun within 7'30 min : [url=for the brave]https://www.speedrun.com/raging_ball[/url] .

See you soon !
